# Exercise Solutions {#sec-exercise-solutions}

Worked solutions for the end-of-chapter exercises are published as a separate, shorter book so that this one stays readable in print. Each solutions chapter follows the numbering used in the corresponding chapter here and reuses that chapter's data and code. Try the exercises before reading the solutions; most of the value is in the attempt.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
The solutions are available at [solutions/index.html](../solutions/index.html), with a PDF download in their sidebar.
:::

::: {.content-visible unless-format="html"}
The solutions are available online next to the book, in the `solutions/` folder, and as a separate PDF.
:::
